# shoal_me (Data Source)

The principal the provider is authenticated as (`GET /v1/me`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "shoal_me" "current" {}

output "acting_as" {
  value = data.shoal_me.current.actor
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `actor` (String) e.g. `sa:terraform` or `user:ada@acme.io`.
- `kind` (String) `user`, `service` or `system`.
- `namespaces` (Set of String) Namespaces the caller can see.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant slug.
- `user_id` (String)
